items.evidence: one_to_many(p300, 40, beads, sample_wells, mix_after=(10,40)) covers all 96 wells with 10 mixes, and the 5 min incubation comment comes before the magnet comment.

The 'Engage magnetic module; wait 5 min' comment is present. many_to_one removes 90 uL from every well to waste, then two 200 uL ethanol add and remove cycles follow, and the simulator checks all passed.
The code records a 5 min air dry and the magnet disengage, adds 50 uL water per well with mix(10, 40), then records the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage.
many_to_many(p300, 45, sample_wells, elution_wells) pairs wells in the same order, and the end_state:elution_plate check passed.
Every helper picks up a new tip per well and drops it after, and the no_cross_contamination and tip checks passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps. It uses a fresh tip per well, the right volumes, matching well pairing and the non-simulated steps recorded as comments. All measured checks passed.
